title: BiomX Inc. Form 8-K Current Report — Framework Supply Agreement with Israel Railways
summary: BiomX Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that its subsidiary Zorro Net Ltd. entered a framework supply agreement with Israel Railways on April 15, 2026, to provide AI-powered animal detection and deterrence alert stations, following a pilot program with approximately 98% success rate. The initial agreement term is 12 months with an option to extend, covering maintenance of 15 existing stations with additional orders at Israel's discretion. Israel Railways also holds an unexercised option to invest up to $1,000,000 for 20% of Zorronet.
key_points: BiomX Inc. (ticker PHGE, listed on NYSE) filed 8-K on April 15-16, 2026 disclosing framework supply agreement between subsidiary Zorro Net Ltd. and Israel Railways
Agreement covers AI-powered animal detection/deterrence alert stations for rail facilities, with installation, maintenance, and support services
Pilot program conducted over preceding year invested approximately NIS 800,000 (~$266,000) and achieved ~98% success rate keeping large animals off tracks
Initial agreement term: 12 months from execution, with Israel Railways option to extend for additional 12 months
Israel Railways has unexercised option (from November 2023) to invest up to $1,000,000 for 20% equity stake in Zorronet, subject to pilot success
Payment terms: 45 days from invoice submission, subject to Israel Railways approval; no minimum quantity obligation beyond 15 existing stations
